context: News discussion about Cool Japan branding and public criticism
purpose: Teach: 都道府県/施行/非難/当該/公的/回収/側面/ジャパン

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ねえ、クールジャパンの戦略がまた非難されてるって記事、読んだ?
lines.en: Hey, did you read the article about the Cool Japan strategy being criticized again?
lines.style: Casual male university student opener with rising curious intonation, slightly informal tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、見た見た。当該プロジェクトに公的なお金が使われてるのが問題なんでしょ?
lines.en: Yeah, I saw it. The issue is that public money is being used on the project in question, right?
lines.style: Teen girl agreeing eagerly, repeating verb for emphasis, briefly borrowing news vocabulary from the article

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう、おれが特にやばいと思ったのは、各都道府県でバラバラに動いてて統一感がないところな。
lines.en: Right, what I personally thought was really bad is the part where each prefecture is moving independently with no unity.
lines.style: Male university student using おれ first-person, analytical but casual delivery with mild slang やばい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 確かに。せっかく良い制度が施行されても、現場でうまく回ってないって感じだよね。
lines.en: True. Even when a good system gets put into effect, it doesn't seem to function well on the ground.
lines.style: Teen girl offering thoughtful agreement, mid-tempo reflective tone with confirming sentence ender

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外向けに作ったグッズが売れなくて、結局回収してるって話もあるらしいよ。
lines.en: I heard there are stories of overseas-targeted goods not selling and ending up being recalled.
lines.style: Male student sharing rumor secondhand, slightly amused tone with hedging らしい ending

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、もったいない!税金なのに、誰がちゃんと責任取るんだろうね。
lines.en: Whaaat, what a waste! It's taxpayer money, so I wonder who's actually taking responsibility.
lines.style: Teen girl expressing exasperation with drawn out interjection, rhetorical wondering question

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メイドインジャパンのブランド力って側面では強いから、もっと別のアプローチが要るよな。
lines.en: On the Made in Japan brand-power side it's strong, so a different approach is needed.
lines.style: Male university student concluding analytically with soft assertion な ender, slightly philosophical tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。次のステップでは若い人の声も聞いてほしいよね。
lines.en: Totally that. For the next step, I want them to listen to young people's voices too.
lines.style: Teen girl emphatic agreement using slang ほんとそれ, hopeful concluding wish with よね tag
